params.body:
## Why

Trends appear on gentells.com and in members' Observatory screens with text a model wrote, and nobody on the editorial team has read it first. On 9 November the site stopped showing that text for this reason. This PR adds the missing step: a person from the editorial team stands behind a trend before anyone outside the team reads it. The team can also shape the text with a prompt, and sees what the site will show before checking.

## What

**The check** (`core/insight-check.mjs`)
- Each trend has a check: `stands`, `declined`, or `carried` (trends that were on the site when checking started, shown as they are and first in the queue). A check pins the text that was checked (headline, narrative, the four reading fields) and records who checked it and when.
- After the start, members, guest Ask and the site see only checked trends, in the checked text. A later edit does not reach them until someone checks again. A check follows a trend through `superseded_by`.
- Routes: `GET/POST /insights/:id/check`, `GET /insight-checks` (the queue, in order: carried, changed since check, ready). Editors and admins only.
- `bin/insight-checks.mjs`: counts what the start would carry; `--start --by=<name>` starts it. Nothing changes until it is run on the box.
- Desk mail: `insights-to-check` opens the queue.

**Shaping with a prompt** (`core/insight-shape.mjs`)
- `POST /insights/:id/shape` with `{request, draft}` rewrites a trend from its own evidence in the house voice (phase `trend-shape`, Opus), runs the plain-language and headline checks, retries once with the problems named, and returns before and after. It writes nothing; the dashboard saves through `/store/patch`, so the edit history is kept.

**gentells.com**
- `projection-trends` sends the reading's prose again, but only for a trend whose check stands, in the checked text, with `checked_at`. Carried and unchecked trends stay measured only.
- `GET /insights/:id/site-preview`: what the site shows, or would show once checked (rule, on site, hidden by hand, checked, text, shown, tags, counts, momentum). Editors and admins only.
- `visibleFor` caches on the check log as well, so the projection worker sees a check at once rather than a minute later.

## Tests

1850 of 1850 pass, tsc clean. New: `insight-check`, `insight-shape`, `guest-checked`; `site-trends-by-rule` covers the feed and the preview.

Shaping was tested against a mocked model answer, not the live model.

## Order and after merge

Merge this first; the site and dashboard PRs read what it sends. After deploy, on the box: `node bin/insight-checks.mjs` (count only), then `node bin/insight-checks.mjs --start --by=<name>`.
params.title: A person from the editorial team checks a trend before anyone outside the team reads it
